turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: That's a really interesting observation! "Vagina" specifically refers to the muscular canal leading from the vulva to the cervix. "Female genital area" is a broader term encompassing the vulva—the external structures—as well as the vagina, uterus, and other internal organs. It's a bit like the difference between saying "hand" versus "arm"—one is a part of the other, but they aren't interchangeable.
